NAME: Stage 2 Reserve & Terminal Shortfall (Energy Domain)
FORMULA: min J2 = sum(max(0, E_EBR_target(t) - E_reserve_avail(t))) + max(0, E_terminal_target - E(H))

NAME: Stage 3 Fuel Minimization
FORMULA: min J3 = sum((F_base * u_diesel(t) + F_marg * p_diesel(t)) * dt + Startup_Fuel * v_start(t))

NAME: Battery Energy Transition
FORMULA: E(t+1) - E(t) - eta_chg * p_chg(t) * dt + (p_dis(t) / eta_dis) * dt = 0

NAME: Bus-Bar Power Balance
FORMULA: p_sol_used + p_wind_used + p_dis + p_diesel - p_served - p_chg - p_flex = 0
